locator: III.2, 201b31-33: ἐνέργεια μὲν εἶναί τις δοκεῖ, ἀτελὴς δέ
interpretation: Motion is thought to be an actuality, but incomplete, because the potential whose actuality it is is incomplete. Read as: what is being moved toward r is not yet actually r. Reading choice: 'incomplete' is taken as not yet having the perfection toward which the motion goes; Aristotle does not state it in those words. The occurrence-level reading of the same lines is STMT-MOTION-INCOMPLETE-ACTUALITY; this claim does not identify the two.
